assay: bulk RNA-seq of low-speed-pelleted platelet-derived plasma particles (CD41+CD45-CD235a-)
sample_inclusion: 3 female ME/CFS cases and 3 female healthy controls, each at baseline (BL, pre-CPET) and 24 h post-CPET (PC) (S2.6.p4, FIG6 E-F, S4.4.5.1.p1)
repeated_measure_unit: individual (each subject sampled at BL and PC)
primary_estimand: Difference between ME/CFS and controls in the within-individual exercise response (PC/BL ratio, 'deltaRNA') of platelet-particle gene expression, i.e. disease x time difference-in-differences controlling for individual of origin (S2.6.p1, S2.6.p4, S4.5.1.3.p3, S4.5.3.p1)
planned_contrasts: paired deltaRNA (PC/BL) ME vs HC, controlling for individual (S2.6.p4, FIG6F, Data S14; paper reports GSEA only: platelet-function sets up, translation sets down; no per-gene DEG count for bulk)
ME vs HC at BL (S2.6.p4, Data S13: transcriptomes differ; DEG count not given in text)
ME vs HC at PC (S2.6.p4: no significant differential expression)
paper_method: DESeq2 on STAR GeneCounts (genes >10 reads in >=3 libraries) for cohort comparisons; paired analysis = per-individual PC/BL ratio of DESeq2-normalized counts floored at 1, geometric mean per cohort, log2(case/control) ranked into fgsea (genes with >=2 ratios per cohort) (S4.5.3.p1, S4.5.1.3.p3)
paper_results: BL: platelet-function GSEA sets down in ME; PC: no significant DE; paired: platelet-function sets up and translation sets down in ME ratios vs HC (FIG6C,F)
